items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: And somehow he, he happened to get his own little, little labor. He had a labor. And, uh, so we went on and got together and recorded.

ctx.x: Oh, Janellis, that's what I'm saying. And, oh, what did he do? Was he having another business or something?

Well, I don't know what he, I know he was very interested in, he was interested in talents. He, uh, he was very interested in me and he always thought that I should have gotten a break in this field. And, and we've been friends a while and he always told me if you ever get a chance, you're on record. And somehow he, he happened to get his own little, little labor. He had a labor. And, uh, so we went on and got together and recorded.
Did they have anybody else on the ego label?
